sections.text: Azure Wave of the Water Dragon

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 40 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases water elemental attack by 4 for 90 seconds.
Only [Five Sacred Beasts] Seiryu can be used as Unlocking Potential material
